name: Suing Someone
overview: Scripture teaches that believers should pursue reconciliation and wisdom rather than litigation when wronged. Jesus instructs us to address offenses privately to restore relationships, moving beyond the old principle of 'an eye for an eye' toward forgiveness and peace. Judging others harshly is condemned, as it reveals one's own faults, and believers are encouraged to seek God's wisdom in handling conflicts. Ultimately, God's plans are for peace and hope, guiding us away from contentious disputes toward restoration.
